en.headline: Blue Lock anime exhibition opens at AIRSIDE as first overseas stop
en.dek: The official EGOIST EXHIBITION runs from 6 to 24 November at the Kai Tak mall, with immersive displays and limited merchandise.
body: The official Blue Lock anime exhibition, titled EGOIST EXHIBITION the animation, opened on Friday at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak as its first stop outside Japan.

Organisers said the show runs daily from 11:00 to 21:00 until 24 November, with last entry at 20:00. It features original animation materials, life-size character displays, recreated scenes and a Hong Kong-limited pop-up store.

Tickets start at HK$78 for early-bird single entry, HK$98 standard, HK$188 for pairs and HK$219 for a family of two adults and one child under 12. The exhibition is licensed by Medialink and organised by Cross Studio.

zh.headline: 《藍色監獄》官方展覽登陸啟德AIRSIDE 成海外首站
zh.dek: EGOIST EXHIBITION今日起至24日於AIRSIDE舉行，設沉浸式展區及限定商品，每日11時至21時開放。
body: 官方動畫展《藍色監獄展 EGOIST EXHIBITION the animation》周五於啟德AIRSIDE開幕，為日本巡迴後的海外首站。
主辦方表示，展覽至11月24日，每日上午11時至晚上9時開放，最後入場晚上8時。內容包括原畫及動畫素材、等身角色展示、經典場景還原及香港限定快閃店。
票價早鳥單人78港元、標準98元、雙人188元、家庭票（兩成人加一名12歲以下兒童）219元。展覽由羚邦授權、Cross Studio主辦。
